items.title: 11.4.4 Graph of y = tan x from -pi to pi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 209-210: 11.4.4 Graph of y = tan x: behaviour near +/-pi/2 cases (i)-(iv) (ii)-(iv) misprinted, table 0 to pi, graph -360 to 360 with asymptotes, properties (i)-(viii).

blocks.text: Ab hum teesra aur sab se dilchasp graph banayenge: \(y = \tan x\). Yeh sine aur cosine jaisi narm lehar nahin. Is ke graph mein kuch jagah aisi hain jahan curve ek dum aasman ki taraf bhaag jata hai aur phir neeche se wapas aata hai. Wajah samajh li to graph khud ba khud samajh aa jayega.

Kitab kehti hai: hum jaante hain ke \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\) aur \(\tan(\pi - x) = -\tan x\). Is liye sirf \(x = 0^{\circ}, 30^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}\) ki values se poori table ban sakti hai. Matlab \(120^{\circ}\) aur \(150^{\circ}\) ki values \(60^{\circ}\) aur \(30^{\circ}\) wali values ko minus laga kar mil jayengi.
Saath hi humein maloom hai ke \(x = \pm 90^{\circ}\) par \(\tan x\) undefined (be-maani, jis ki koi value nahin) hai. Ab dekhte hain ke jab \(x\) in angles ke bilkul qareeb jata hai to kya hota hai:

items: (i) Jab \(x\) bayen (left) taraf se \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke qareeb jata hai, yani \(x \to \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{-}\): angle Quadrant I mein hai aur \(\tan x\) be-hadd barhta jata hai (\(\tan x \to +\infty\)).

(ii) Jab \(x\) dayen (right) taraf se \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke qareeb jata hai, yani \(x \to \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{+}\): angle Quadrant II mein hai aur \(\tan x\) be-hadd ghat-ta jata hai (\(\tan x \to -\infty\)).

(iii) Jab \(x\) bayen taraf se \(-\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke qareeb jata hai, yani \(x \to \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{-}\): angle Quadrant III mein hai aur \(\tan x\) be-hadd barhta jata hai (\(\tan x \to +\infty\)).

(iv) Jab \(x\) dayen taraf se \(-\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke qareeb jata hai, yani \(x \to \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{+}\): angle Quadrant IV mein hai aur \(\tan x\) be-hadd ghat-ta jata hai (\(\tan x \to -\infty\)).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ke cases (ii), (iii) aur (iv) mein direction ya quadrant ghalat chhapa hai (aur Quadrant ko 'Quard' likha hai). Kitab yeh chhapti hai:
(ii) 'tan x increases indefinitely in Quard IV': sahi yeh hai ke \(90^{\circ}\) se zara aage (jaise \(91^{\circ}\)) angle Quadrant II mein hai, aur \(\tan x\) bohat bara negative hota jata hai: \(\tan x \to -\infty\).
(iii) 'Quard II': \(-90^{\circ}\) se zara peeche (jaise \(-91^{\circ}\), jo \(269^{\circ}\) ke barabar hai) angle Quadrant III mein hai; \(\tan x \to +\infty\) theek hai.
(iv) 'increases indefinitely in Quard III': \(-90^{\circ}\) se zara aage (jaise \(-89^{\circ}\)) angle Quadrant IV mein hai, aur \(\tan x \to -\infty\).
Case (i) bilkul sahi hai. Kitab ki apni table (\(90^{\circ} + 0\) par \(-\infty\)) aur graph bhi inhi sahi baaton ki tasdeeq karte hain. Hum ne upar sahi version likha hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh sab hota kyun hai? Kyun ke \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\). \(\pm 90^{\circ}\) ke qareeb \(\sin x\) taqreeban \(\pm 1\) hota hai aur \(\cos x\) taqreeban \(0\). Aur jab kisi number ko bohat chhote number se divide karein to jawab bohat bara aata hai: \(1 \div 0.01 = 100\), \(1 \div 0.0001 = 10000\). Sign ka faisla quadrant karta hai:
\(89^{\circ}\) (Quadrant I): \(\tan 89^{\circ} \approx 57.3\), bara positive.
\(91^{\circ}\) (Quadrant II): \(\tan 91^{\circ} \approx -57.3\), bara negative.
\(-91^{\circ}\) (Quadrant III): \(\tan(-91^{\circ}) \approx 57.3\), bara positive.
\(-89^{\circ}\) (Quadrant IV): \(\tan(-89^{\circ}) \approx -57.3\), bara negative.
Calculator par khud check kijiye (degree mode mein): \(\tan 89.9^{\circ}\) aur \(\tan 90.1^{\circ}\). Aap dekhenge ke \(90^{\circ}\) ke do taraf values ka sign ulat jata hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Quadrant pehchaan-ne ka aasan tareeqa: \(-91^{\circ}\) ko \(360^{\circ}\) jor kar positive bana lijiye: \(-91^{\circ} + 360^{\circ} = 269^{\circ}\), jo \(180^{\circ}\) aur \(270^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan hai, yani Quadrant III. Isi tarah \(-89^{\circ} + 360^{\circ} = 271^{\circ}\), yani Quadrant IV.
Tangent ka period \(\pi\) hai, is liye pehle hum graph sirf \(0\) se \(\pi\) (yani \(0^{\circ}\) se \(180^{\circ}\)) tak banayenge.
\(\therefore\) \(y = \tan x\) ko satisfy karne wale ordered pairs ki table yeh hai:

blocks.caption: Ordered pairs satisfying \(y = \tan x\), \(0 \le x \le \pi\) (printed across the page in the book; turned on its side here)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Table mein \(90^{\circ} - 0\) ka matlab hai '\(90^{\circ}\) se zara sa kam', aur \(90^{\circ} + 0\) ka matlab '\(90^{\circ}\) se zara sa ziada'. \(+\infty\) aur \(-\infty\) koi number nahin jo graph par lagaya ja sake; yeh sirf batate hain ke curve \(90^{\circ}\) ke qareeb bohat ooper chala jata hai, ya bohat neeche se aata hai.
Khari line \(x = 90^{\circ}\), jis ke curve bohat qareeb to jata hai magar kabhi chhoota nahin, asymptote (kabhi na milne wali line) kehlati hai. Ise dashed banate hain. Jaise koi shakhs deewar ki taraf har qadam pehle se aadha chale: qareeb hota jayega, magar deewar tak kabhi nahin pahunchega.
\(90^{\circ}\) ke baad wali values: \(\tan 120^{\circ} = \tan(180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = -\tan 60^{\circ} = -1.73\), aur \(\tan 150^{\circ} = -\tan 30^{\circ} = -0.58\).
Chunke \(\tan x\) ka period \(\pi\) hai, is liye \(y = \tan x\) ka \(-360^{\circ}\) se \(360^{\circ}\) tak graph yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Graph of y = tan x from minus 360 to 360 degrees. Magenta axes; the x-axis is marked every 30 degrees and the y-axis at 1, 1.7, 2, minus 1, minus 1.7 and minus 2. Dotted vertical asymptotes with arrows at both ends at minus 270, minus 90, 90 and 270 degrees. Between neighbouring asymptotes one increasing branch comes up from far below, crosses the x-axis at minus 180, 0 or 180 degrees and rises steeply; the outer half-branches start at (minus 360, 0) and end at (360, 0).
blocks.caption: Graph of y = tan x from −360° to 360° (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke \(y = \tan x\) wale graph mein \(y\)-axis par \(-1\) ki jagah sirf \(1\) chhapa hai, minus ka nishaan gayab hai (us ke neeche \(-1.7\) aur \(-2\) theek chhape hain). Sahi label \(-1\) hai, jaisa hamari drawing mein hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Heading mein '\(-\pi\) se \(\pi\)' likha hai, magar kitab ki figure is se ziada, \(-360^{\circ}\) se \(360^{\circ}\) tak dikhati hai. \(-\pi\) se \(\pi\) wala hissa figure ke beech mein hai: \(-90^{\circ}\) aur \(90^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ek poori shaakh (branch), aur dono taraf aadhi aadhi shaakh.
Period \(\pi\) hone ka matlab: har shaakh, origin wali shaakh ki copy hai, bas \(180^{\circ}\) ke kisi multiple jitni khiski hui. Aur ghor kijiye: har shaakh bayen se dayen ooper hi chadhti hai. Do asymptotes ke darmiyan tangent hamesha barhta hai, kabhi ghat-ta nahin.
Properties of graph of tangent function (y = tan x)
Kitab tangent graph ki aath properties batati hai:

items: (i) Domain un values ke ilawa tamam real numbers hain jahan function undefined hai: \(\tan x\) ka domain \((-\infty, \infty)\) hai, magar \(x \ne (2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\), jahan \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).
(ii) Range mein tamam real numbers shamil hain: \((-\infty, \infty)\).
(iii) \(\tan x\) ka graph tamam real numbers par continuous nahin. Yeh \(x = (2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) par toot-ta hai, jahan \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).
(iv) Tangent function ka period \(\pi\) hai. Formula ki zubaan mein: \(\tan(\theta + \pi) = \tan\theta\).
(v) Tangent odd function hai, kyun ke us ka graph origin ke gird symmetric hai. Formula: \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\).
(vi) Tangent ka \(x\)-intercept \(x = \pi n\) par hota hai, jahan \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).
(vii) Tangent ka \(y\)-intercept \(0\) hai: graph origin se guzarta hai.
(viii) Tangent ka amplitude undefined hai, kyun ke is ki koi maximum ya minimum value nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: In properties ko graph par milaiye: (i) aur (iii) asymptotes ki baat karti hain; \((2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) se \(n = -2, -1, 0, 1\) rakhne par \(-270^{\circ}, -90^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}, 270^{\circ}\) milte hain, bilkul figure ki dashed lines. (ii) range sab real numbers hain kyun ke har shaakh neeche \(-\infty\) se ooper \(+\infty\) tak jati hai. (viii) amplitude tab hota hai jab koi sab se ooncha aur sab se neecha point ho; tangent ka koi aisa point nahin, is liye amplitude undefined hai.

blocks.caption: The three graphs compared (our summary of the properties in 11.4.2 to 11.4.4)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Practice ke liye (kitab ka sawal nahin): \(-180^{\circ}\) aur \(180^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan kin angles par \(\tan x = 1.73\) hai? Pehli jagah table se \(60^{\circ}\). Period \(180^{\circ}\) hai, is liye \(60^{\circ} - 180^{\circ} = -120^{\circ}\) par bhi wahi value hogi. Jawab: \(x = 60^{\circ}\) aur \(x = -120^{\circ}\). Tasdeeq: \(\tan(-120^{\circ}) = -\tan 120^{\circ} = -(-1.73) = 1.73\). Sine aur cosine mein ek cycle mein do jawab aate the; tangent mein har shaakh par sirf ek, kyun ke har shaakh sirf chadhti hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\tan 225^{\circ}\) kitna hai? Period \(180^{\circ}\) hai, to \(\tan 225^{\circ} = \tan(180^{\circ} + 45^{\circ}) = \tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Graph par dekhiye: \(225^{\circ}\) wali shaakh, origin wali shaakh ki \(180^{\circ}\) aage copy hai, aur origin wali shaakh \(45^{\circ}\) par \(1\) hai. Aur kya \(\tan x\) kabhi \(1000\) ho sakta hai? Haan! \(90^{\circ}\) ke bohat qareeb, kyun ke range sab real numbers hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: \(y = \tan x\) ka sketch banate waqt pehle asymptotes \(x = \pm 90^{\circ}, \pm 270^{\circ}\) dashed lines se banaiye, phir shaakhein. Curve in lines ke bohat qareeb aaye magar unhein na kaate, na chhooye. Examiner sab se pehle yahi dekhta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Period \(\pi\): do asymptotes ke darmiyan ek shaakh, har \(180^{\circ}\) baad dohrai jati hai.
2. Asymptotes (toot) \(x = (2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) par, jahan \(\tan x\) undefined hai.
3. Range: tamam real numbers; na maximum, na minimum, na amplitude.
4. Zeros \(n\pi\) par; graph origin se guzarta hai; odd function.
5. Asymptote ke bayen \(\tan x \to +\infty\), dayen \(\tan x \to -\infty\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Asymptote ke aar paar shaakhon ko jor dena: wahan graph toota hua hai.
2. Tangent ka period \(2\pi\) likh dena: woh sine aur cosine ka hai; tangent ka \(\pi\) hai.
3. \(\tan 90^{\circ} = \infty\) ko value ki tarah likhna: \(\tan 90^{\circ}\) undefined hai.
4. Kitab ke cases (ii) se (iv) waise hi yaad kar lena: \(90^{\circ}\) ke dayen aur \(-90^{\circ}\) ke dayen \(\tan x \to -\infty\) hota hai, aur quadrants upar wali correction ke mutabiq hain.
